$note: Site logistics of the Faisalabad city road: about 2 km under traffic, built half-width in 500 m stretches. Hot mix from the plant on Jhang Road, crush from Sargodha. All names are invented.

note.en: Entry to the working stretch for dumpers, tippers and asphalt trucks. Flagmen at both ends of the diversion.
Contractor's camp, field laboratory and plant yard.
Crush stockpiles for sub-base and base, pipes for the storm drain, kerb stones.
Kerbs, culvert precast units and pipes for the current stretch only.

rules_text.en: Book every delivery with the site engineer of Chenab Roads. Asphalt trucks covered and at temperature on arrival. No vehicle waits on the open lane. Night work only with the traffic police permit and lighting.

description.en: Crushed stone for sub-base and base from Sargodha
RCC pipes and precast culvert units
Hot-mix asphalt from the Jhang Road plant, laid from the truck

outcome.en: City Traffic Police Faisalabad approved one-way traffic for 45 days.

topic.en: WASA water main relocation, km 0+500 to 1+000

outcome.en: WASA shifted the main; SNGPL gas line still to be moved.
Access ramps to shops kept open during the works.

topic.en: FDA road cut permission for the storm drain outfall

stage_2_title.en: Base course, asphalt and road furniture

water_consumer.en: Compaction water and dust suppression by bowser

parking_note.en: Staff park at the camp; no parking along the working stretch.

heavy_title.en: Motor grader and vibratory roller to site

heavy_route_notes.en: On low-bed trailers from the Motorway M-4 interchange via Jhang Road, night move only.

spoil_title.en: Unsuitable material from the subgrade to the approved spoil site

dust_description.en: Dust on shops along Jhang Road during the sub-base work.

dust_response.en: Water bowser every two hours, speed limit 20 km/h in the working stretch.

noise_description.en: Vibratory roller working after 22:00 near the residential lane.

crane_2_consumer.en: Mobile crane for the culvert units

welfare_consumer.en: Camp office, field laboratory and labour camp

telecom_point.en: PTCL exchange line to the camp

heavy_origin.en: Plant yard of Chenab Roads, Lahore

oversize_conditions.en: Night move approved by the traffic police with an escort.

spoil_destination.en: Spoil site approved by the FDA

customs_title.en: Imported LED street lights and signal controllers
